name: Clutch of Undeath — the Otherwise branch applies to a non-Zombie
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py ('otherwise' / 'if kicked … instead' theme). 'Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 as long as it's a Zombie. Otherwise, it gets -3/-3.' The Otherwise sentence shares a line with the sentence it contrasts with and conditions attach per line, so it produced nothing. _splitConditionalBranches now moves it to an appended line with the negated condition ('it is not true that …'). Walking Corpse (Zombie 2/2) is 5/5; Grizzly Bears is -1/-1.
